summary.id: Kab. Aceh Tengah memiliki indeks risiko stunting 81/100 (kategori sangat tinggi), menempati peringkat #3 dari 23 wilayah di Aceh. Pendorong risiko utama di wilayah ini adalah Akses Sanitasi Layak (43.6%) serta Akses Air Minum Layak (56.8%). Di sisi lain, capaian Rata-rata Lama Sekolah Perempuan / Pendidikan Ibu (47.3%) berperan sebagai faktor pelindung yang menahan laju risiko lebih lanjut.
summary.en: Kab. Aceh Tengah records a stunting risk index of 81/100 (very high risk), ranking #3 out of 23 districts in Aceh. The primary risk drivers are Improved Sanitation Access (43.6%) and Clean Drinking Water Access (56.8%). Conversely, local performance in Maternal Secondary Education Completion (47.3%) acts as a protective buffer mitigating further risk escalation.

description.id: Persentase rumah tangga yang memiliki akses terhadap fasilitas sanitasi layak dan aman.
description.en: Percentage of households with access to improved and safely managed sanitation facilities.

impactMechanism.id: Sanitasi buruk memicu infeksi berulang seperti diare dan Environmental Enteric Dysfunction (EED) yang menghambat penyerapan nutrisi pada usus balita.
impactMechanism.en: Poor sanitation triggers recurrent diarrheal infections and Environmental Enteric Dysfunction (EED), impairing gut nutrient absorption in toddlers.

description.id: Persentase rumah tangga yang menggunakan sumber air minum terlindung dan bebas kontaminasi E. coli.
description.en: Percentage of households using protected drinking water sources free from E. coli contamination.

impactMechanism.id: Paparan air terkontaminasi patogen selama 1.000 Hari Pertama Kehidupan (HPK) mengalihkan energi metabolisme pertumbuhan linier untuk melawan infeksi.
impactMechanism.en: Pathogen-contaminated water during the first 1,000 days diverts metabolic energy away from linear skeletal growth toward fighting chronic infection.

description.id: Persentase penduduk yang berada di bawah Garis Kemiskinan daerah.
description.en: Percentage of population living below the regional poverty line.

impactMechanism.id: Keterbatasan daya beli rumah tangga menurunkan kemampuan memperoleh pangan hewani berkualitas tinggi serta layanan kesehatan preventif.
impactMechanism.en: Constrained household purchasing power restricts access to nutrient-dense animal-source foods and preventive maternal-child healthcare.

description.id: Persentase ibu hamil yang memperoleh layanan pemeriksaan kehamilan minimal 6 kali termasuk USG oleh dokter.
description.en: Percentage of pregnant women receiving at least 6 antenatal checkups including ultrasound screening.

impactMechanism.id: Pemeriksaan ANC K6 mendeteksi secara dini Kurang Energi Kronis (KEK) ibu hamil dan komplikasi pertumbuhan janin sebelum lahir.
impactMechanism.en: Complete ANC K6 visits enable early detection of maternal Chronic Energy Deficiency (CED) and fetal growth faltering before birth.

description.id: Persentase anak usia 12–23 bulan yang telah menerima seluruh vaksin imunisasi dasar sesuai jadwal nasional.
description.en: Percentage of children aged 12–23 months who received all scheduled basic immunizations.

impactMechanism.id: Anak tanpa imunisasi lengkap rentan mengalami penyakit infeksi berat (campak, pneumonia, rotavirus) yang memicu penurunan berat badan akut dan gagal tumbuh.
impactMechanism.en: Unimmunized children face severe vaccine-preventable infections (measles, pneumonia, rotavirus) that trigger acute weight loss and growth faltering.

description.id: Persentase penduduk yang mengonsumsi kalori dan zat gizi di bawah kebutuhan minimum untuk hidup sehat.
description.en: Percentage of population consuming dietary energy and nutrients below minimum requirements for active health.

impactMechanism.id: Kerawanan pangan kronis di tingkat rumah tangga menyebabkan defisit energi-protein jangka panjang pada balita dan ibu menyusui.
impactMechanism.en: Chronic household food insecurity causes sustained protein-energy deficits in both nursing mothers and young children.

description.id: Persentase bayi baru lahir dengan berat badan kurang dari 2.500 gram.
description.en: Percentage of live births weighing less than 2,500 grams.

impactMechanism.id: Bayi BBLR memulai kehidupan dengan cadangan nutrisi rendah dan memiliki risiko 2,5 hingga 3,5 kali lebih tinggi mengalami stunting pada usia 2 tahun.
impactMechanism.en: Low-birth-weight infants start life with depleted nutrient stores and carry a 2.5x to 3.5x higher risk of stunting by age two.

description.id: Persentase perempuan usia 20–24 tahun yang menikah sebelum usia 18 tahun.
description.en: Percentage of women aged 20–24 who were married before reaching age 18.

impactMechanism.id: Kehamilan pada usia remaja menyebabkan kompetisi nutrisi antara tubuh ibu yang masih tumbuh dengan janin yang dikandungnya.
impactMechanism.en: Adolescent pregnancy creates biological nutrient competition between the still-growing mother and the developing fetus.

description.id: Persentase ibu hamil dengan kadar hemoglobin (Hb) kurang dari 11,0 g/dL.
description.en: Percentage of pregnant women with hemoglobin (Hb) concentration below 11.0 g/dL.

impactMechanism.id: Anemia defisiensi besi saat kehamilan menghambat suplai oksigen plasenta, meningkatkan risiko pertumbuhan janin terhambat (IUGR) dan BBLR.
impactMechanism.en: Iron-deficiency anemia during pregnancy restricts placental oxygen transport, elevating Intrauterine Growth Restriction (IUGR) and low birth weight.

description.id: Persentase bayi usia 0–5 bulan yang hanya menerima ASI tanpa tambahan makanan/minuman lain.
description.en: Percentage of infants aged 0–5 months receiving only breast milk without other foods or liquids.

impactMechanism.id: ASI eksklusif memberikan antibodi imunoglobulin dan nutrisi optimal yang melindungi bayi dari infeksi saluran cerna dini.
impactMechanism.en: Exclusive breastfeeding delivers essential immunoglobulins and complete bioavailable nutrients that protect against early enteric infections.

description.id: Persentase anak usia 6–23 bulan yang mengonsumsi minimal 5 dari 8 kelompok pangan termasuk protein hewani.
description.en: Percentage of children aged 6–23 months consuming at least 5 of 8 food groups daily, including animal-source protein.

impactMechanism.id: Kekurangan asam amino esensial dan mikronutrien (zinc, zat besi, kalsium) dari protein hewani saat periode MP-ASI secara langsung menghambat pertumbuhan tulang panjang.
impactMechanism.en: Deficiencies in essential amino acids and micronutrients (zinc, iron, calcium) from animal proteins during complementary feeding directly stunt bone elongation.

label.id: Rata-rata Lama Sekolah Perempuan / Pendidikan Ibu

description.id: Persentase ibu usia reproduktif yang menamatkan pendidikan minimal jenjang menengah atas (SMA/sederajat).
description.en: Percentage of mothers of reproductive age who completed at least upper-secondary education.

impactMechanism.id: Tingkat literasi kesehatan ibu menentukan ketepatan praktik pemberian makan bayi, higienitas rumah tangga, dan kecepatan mencari layanan medis.
impactMechanism.en: Maternal health literacy strongly governs infant feeding practices, household hygiene habits, and timely care-seeking behavior.

title.id: Akselerasi Sanitasi Total Berbasis Masyarakat (STBM) & Stop BABS
title.en: Accelerate Community-Led Total Sanitation (STBM) & Open Defecation Free

action.id: Pembangunan tangki septik komunal dan intervensi STBM di desa lokus prioritas dengan kepemilikan jamban sehat di bawah 65%.
action.en: Deploy communal septic systems and STBM behavioral interventions in priority villages with latrine coverage below 65%.

title.id: Perluasan Jaringan SPAM Desa & Pengawasan Kualitas Air Rumah Tangga
title.en: Expand Rural Piped Water (SPAM) & Household Water Quality Surveillance

action.id: Instalasi jaringan Pamsimas dan uji berkala bakteriologis E. coli pada sumber air rumah tangga keluarga berisiko stunting.
action.en: Install rural piped water systems and conduct routine E. coli bacteriological testing for at-risk households.

title.id: Integrasi Bantuan Sosial Pangan Berbasis Protein Hewani (PKH/BPNT)

action.id: Penajaman sasaran keluarga miskin ekstrem dengan ibu hamil dan baduta agar menerima paket telur, ikan, dan pangan fortifikasi.
action.en: Prioritize extreme-poverty households with pregnant mothers and children under two for subsidized eggs, fish, and fortified foods.

title.id: Layanan ANC Terpadu &jemput Bola Ibu Hamil di Wilayah Terpencil
title.en: Mobile Integrated ANC & Ultrasound Outreach in Remote Subdistricts

action.id: Optimalisasi USG dasar di seluruh Puskesmas dan penjadwalan bidan desa untuk pelacakan ibu hamil KEK.
action.en: Equip all community health centers with basic obstetric ultrasound and deploy village midwives to track CED mothers.

methodology.source: Simulasi Terpadu SSGI Kemenkes RI, Susenas BPS & Indeks Khusus Penanganan Stunting (IKPS)

disclaimer.id: Indeks Risiko StuntWatch merupakan instrumen pendukung keputusan perencanaan wilayah (decision-support) dan bukan alat diagnosis klinis individu. Nilai kontribusi faktor dihitung menggunakan dekomposisi aditif terhadap rata-rata nasional.
disclaimer.en: The StuntWatch Risk Index is a regional planning decision-support instrument and not an individual clinical diagnostic tool. Factor contributions are derived via additive SHAP-style decomposition relative to national benchmarks.
